description: Test login endpoint with credentials from successful registration. Verify response returns 200 OK with token, user data, and organizations array.

input.prerequisite: User must be registered first (from Test Case 2)

passCriteria: Response contains 'token' field with JWT access token
Response contains 'user' object with correct email
Response contains 'organizations' array with at least one org
Email in response matches login email
failureIndicators: HTTP status is 401 'Invalid email or password'
